description: This file contains tests for the URL redaction module, including functions that identify sensitive URL components, redact sensitive data, and recognize configuration paths that may embed URLs with secrets.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrl
methods.description: Redacts userinfo and sensitive query parameters from URLs.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrlLikeString
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information in URL-like strings.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlQueryParamName
methods.description: Checks if a query parameter name is considered sensitive.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlConfigPath
methods.description: Determines if a config path may embed URL secrets.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintTag
methods.description: Checks if an object has the URL secret hint tag.
